fields.summary_ko.0: For ExxonMobil, the key assessment criterion is whether it can sustain high-margin growth in upstream barrels nearby and maintain structural cost reduction capabilities, and analyst consensus reflects 1.5% annual earnings growth and profit margin expansion from 9.1% to 12.6% over three years.
fields.summary_ko.1: Improved recovery rate technology in Permian, high-margin barrel production in Guyana, and ability to leverage refining margins are critical to achieving net income of $47.4B by 2029 (currently $32.8B), and at the same time, the current 22.5x P/E may compress to 17.4x by 2029.
